summary: Backend (9/9 pytest passed) + Frontend end-to-end validated. Uploaded /root/lhpp.pdf (126 pages) successfully. Async analyze flow polls to 'analyzed'. AI detail mode returns >40 docs with matched_by='ai', ordered non-overlapping ranges covering pages 1-126, and 'Spesifikasi Teknik Mesin' spans page 5. Heuristic mode returns >20 docs (fix confirmed for repeated-header issue). Section granularity returns fewer docs than detail. PUT documents persists section and records corrections. Split runs async, produces valid PDFs (size>0, %PDF header), and download-zip returns valid ZIP with matching count in <60s. Frontend: sample -> granularity-select, use-ai-switch, analyze-btn visible; analysis-progress shows during analysis; detection-table renders with section-row-* groupings and 'AI' badges; split-btn triggers split-results view with SIUjang Ready checklist and Download ZIP button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handler.

_run_analysis creates a background task via asyncio.create_task without tracking; if two concurrent analyze calls hit the same pid they can race. The 'status==analyzing' early-return partially guards this, but there's a window between get_project and update_one that isn't atomic.
download-zip rebuilds PDFs from source on every call (slow for large PDFs re-request); consider caching the built ZIP once status='split'.
matched_by contains 'ai' string tag - good; but 'required' logic in _run_analysis excludes any doc whose section=='Pembukaan' or matched_by contains 'cover'. This is implicit; document the rule.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /root/lhpp.pdf, plus sample project created for regression
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend analyze/split are async now - poll GET /api/projects/{pid} for status transitions ('analyzing'->'analyzed', 'splitting'->'split'). Use POST params use_ai (bool) and granularity ('detail'|'section'). Detail mode on lhpp.pdf yields ~90+ AI docs; section yields ~10-30. All 9 tests take ~2 min due to AI latency.
